The main takeaway from our work is that
a nonlinear MPC can be used online to control an aerial manipulator with a limited computational unit and that the system redundancy can be exploited to achieve several tasks simultaneously.
the aerial manipulation problem is feasible and that the use of a nonlinear model predictive control strategy is a promising approach to solve it.
